BJP MP Sambit Patra targets Rahul Gandhi and the INDIA bloc over allegations of vote theft and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Reacting to the Opposition's 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' rally at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan, Patra questions the 2024 election allegations, challenges Rahul Gandhi to approach the court and disputes the Opposition's claims about rally attendance.
The Indian Express brings you comprehensive coverage of global & indian politics, election news, business news, world affairs, sports, entertainment, Bollywood, and public policy.
